about: Kconfig values the firmware depends on. tools/check_sdkconfig.py holds sdkconfig.defaults and every sdkconfig.v* to them; the reason for each is the page named in 'why'.

required.why: The render runs from PSRAM through the I-cache both cores share; at 16 kB sixteen streamed voices cost 844 us a block against 613. CLAUDE.md, Build Gotchas.
Keeps the USB interrupt on core 1; on core 0 a PSRAM heap walk made the DWC2 drop speaker packets. docs/subsystems/audio-routing.md.
Code runs from PSRAM; the image-size budget in config/image_budget.json assumes it.
Read-only data lives in PSRAM; the image-size budget assumes it.
The image is copied into PSRAM, so its size is the UI's memory; hot paths are -O2 per file in main/CMakeLists.txt.
Code page 437 has no Polish letters; a folder named with them could not be opened. CLAUDE.md, Fonts.
The display path and SCREENSHOT render RGB888.
600 kB let decoded thumbnails take what the kit selector needs (bad_alloc, reboot). CLAUDE.md, Build Gotchas.
An LVGL assert is a panic with a reset record, not LVGL's while(1). main/lvgl_assert/.
USB transfer mode's measured cost and speed are for this buffer. docs/subsystems/usb-transfer-mode.md.
Every CDC verb runs on the main task; replies are built in static buffers to fit it.
The prebuilt streamer is opt-in; the default image carries the native engine only. docs/subsystems/sampler-engine.md.

required_in_revisions.why: It puts ~68 kB of LVGL blend code in IRAM; off is +67.8 kB of internal RAM. CLAUDE.md, Build Gotchas.
With LV_COLOR_DEPTH 24 every opaque layer is rendered in it, and SCREENSHOT snapshots it.
Nothing produces it; the unused renderers cost 41 kB of image.

forbidden_in_defaults.why: sdkconfig.defaults wins over sdkconfig.v*, so setting it here moves the blend code back into IRAM in every build.
